component.name: Bemudex
component.summary: A modern desktop media downloader powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg

description.p: Bemudex is a modern desktop media downloader powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg, built for Linux desktop environments with a modern, lightweight interface. Download videos, playlists, audio tracks and albums with metadata embedding, thumbnail support, queue management and automatic engine updates.

ul.li: MP3, FLAC, WAV and M4A audio downloads
Automatic recovery from failed engine updates

screenshot.caption: Main download interface with video quality selection
Audio download mode with format and bitrate selection
Settings page showing dependencies and system health

description.p: Migrated user interface to native Qt desktop architecture, added individual track cards for playlist downloads with concurrent execution and track retry, custom audio bitrate selection, subtitle embedding, and multiple themes.

Fixed YouTube 403 Forbidden stream error by updating extractor client headers (Mobile Web & iOS), added live window and taskbar application icons, and improved Open Folder file manager responsiveness.
Fixed AppImage compatibility on Arch-based distributions (resolving library loading conflicts for system FFmpeg and SSL certificate lookup issues for update server reachability).
Fixed an issue with the yt-dlp engine self-updater where verification spawned a cloned window and failed due to frozen environment constraints.
